title: Allowed apps for the assistant
scope: Persona remembers these computer-app approvals on the assistant, even when this computer is offline or control is off. Agent tools with separate computer-use permissions are managed separately.
denied: You do not have permission to manage remembered computer-app approvals.
unsupported: This assistant does not support remembered computer-app approvals for this computer.
invalid_response: The assistant returned an invalid approvals list. Try again.
revoked: Saved approval removed. If app approval is enabled, Persona will ask again next time.
confirm_detail: If app approval is enabled, Persona will ask again the next time it needs this app or screen. Removing this record does not change that setting or stop an operation already in progress.
owner_changed: This computer changed assistants. Refresh the machine page before trying again.
revoke_unsupported: This hub version cannot safely revoke saved approvals. You can view them; update the hub to revoke them.
